events.event_name: eos × NYLON Dewy Lip Shine Pop-Up Truck
events.what_it_is: A one-day branded truck celebrating eos Dewy Lip Shine with product sampling, sweet treats and photo moments on the final day of NYFW.
events.what_is_free: Public access, Dewy Lip Shine product sampling and branded sweet treats are advertised. Promotional inventory is subject to availability.
events.caveats: Two current NYC event listings agree that the activation is open to the public on September 15 from 12–5 PM at 575 Broadway. No RSVP, ticket or organizer-approval requirement is published in those verified listings. Samples and treats are promotional inventory and are not guaranteed to every visitor.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–5 PM at 575 Broadway in SoHo. Walk-in public activation; arrive earlier if product samples or treats are the priority.

events.event_name: Mary Kay Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared Experience
events.address: Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A public NYFW beauty experience built around Mary Kay's Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared campaign, with product giveaways, beauty touch-ups and interactive photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Free public admission, beauty touch-ups and advertised Mary Kay product giveaways. Current event coverage promotes free full-size products; quantities are promotional and availability-dependent.
events.caveats: Mary Kay's official newsroom confirms the campaign and says experiential consumer events are launching in New York this month; current event coverage independently identifies the September 15 Gansevoort Plaza activation. No RSVP or paid ticket requirement is published. Giveaway inventory is not guaranteed to every attendee.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–7 PM at Gansevoort Plaza. Open to the public; no advance RSVP is stated in the verified sources.

events.event_name: Walk the Runway at Century 21 NYC
events.what_it_is: A two-day public Fashion Week runway experience on Century 21's main floor where visitors can walk the runway, be filmed for the store's social stories and customize a tote with iron-on patches.
events.what_is_free: Century 21 says every participating walker receives a free tote, up to five iron-on patches pressed on-site and a $21-off-$100 in-store card, while supplies last where stated.
events.caveats: Century 21's official page explicitly says there is no ticket, invitation, registration or online sign-up. Participating in the runway means being filmed for Century 21's Instagram/TikTok stories; visitors who do not want to be filmed can watch instead. Tote/patch promotional inventory is subject to availability.
events.practical_notes: September 15 and 16, 12–6 PM each day, on the main floor near the Dey Street side. Walk in and join the line; no RSVP required.

events.event_name: National Voter Registration Day NYC Block Party
events.address: Washington Square Park, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: HeadCount's free National Voter Registration Day block party with live music, art, civic activities, brand activations and voter-registration assistance.
events.what_is_free: Free public admission plus advertised brand giveaways and samples, including complimentary Nixie zero-sugar soda while supplies last. Individual promotional items are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: Current listings agree on September 15, 10 AM–6 PM at Washington Square Park and describe the event as free/open to the public. HeadCount has established the NYC National Voter Registration Day block party as a recurring flagship event, but the exact 2026 event page was not surfaced from HeadCount's own site in this pass. Samples and giveaways are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 10 AM–6 PM at Washington Square Park. Walk-in public event; no RSVP or ticket requirement is stated in the verified current listings.

events.event_name: Hempz × Ulta Beauty Serene Waters Pop-Up
events.address: Ulta Beauty Herald Square, 1328 Broadway, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: A one-day Hempz Serene Waters with Magnesium activation outside Ulta Beauty Herald Square with a calm-down experience, product sampling, drinks and promotional prizes.
events.what_is_free: Current listings advertise free magnesium iced teas, lavender cold-foam matchas and Serene Waters mini body lotions while supplies last; the first 50 in line are advertised to receive a Calm Kit. Scratch-offs offer additional prize opportunities.
events.caveats: Two current listings agree on the September 15 location and 12:30–6:30 PM hours and describe the activation as free/open to the public. Promotional drinks, samples, Calm Kits and prizes are quantity-limited. Gifts with purchase may also be offered inside Ulta, but a purchase is not required for the advertised public pop-up experience/free samples.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12:30–6:30 PM outside Ulta Beauty Herald Square. Walk-in; arrive early for the first-50 Calm Kit or other limited samples.
